up: Retrieve all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728455. For each molecule, provide the ChEMBL ID of the molecule (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Use INNER JOIN between compound_records and molecule_dictionary on molregno, and INNER JOIN between compound_records and docs on doc_id to filter for the specified document. Use LEFT JOIN to compound_structures for SMILES. Do not add any additional filters or limits. Return one row per molecule.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728455';
